distinctionsKept: Garlic has a segmented white bulb and separate cloves; onion has a golden round bulb and green shoots. Their whole-vegetable silhouettes remain clear at145px.

Spinach is an open bunch of separate smooth oval leaves and stems; lettuce is a compact ruffled head. Broccoli is green with a branching stalk, while cauliflower is white with a leafy base. These remain useful distinct choices.
Watermelon shows red seeded flesh and green-striped rind; melón shows orange flesh, a central seed cavity and a tan netted rind. No blanket melon-category exclusion.
Ham has a broad pink cut face and slice; steak has brown grill marks and a T-shaped bone. Bacon has long striped strips and salchicha has sealed frankfurter ends. These remain distinguishable.

Pizza toppings are round pepperoni discs, not the new whole frankfurter-style salchicha. The sandwich has only a thin red filling without identifiable ham features. No unseen ham, sausage, tomato, onion or seasoning ingredients were inferred.
Soup has small flat three-lobed green herb sprigs, not the new broccoli florets or smooth whole spinach bunch. No broccoli/spinach soup restrictions were inferred.

Jam has a squat open jar of red contents, honey has an amber jar and dipper, and oil has a stoppered narrow-neck cruet. Their ingredients and containers remain distinct; only oil has the obvious bottle-form overlap with botella.
Chocolate chips remain visible in the cookie, warranting that specific overlap; cake is pink-frosted layered sponge and gelatin is a red fluted ring, so no blanket dessert restriction.

The market foreground corn cobs and grape bunch and the salad cucumber slices are clearly visible at145px. Tiny generic facade decorations and unidentifiable recipe contents were not treated as additional food answers.
